faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PAU Junior Lab/ Field Helper recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Junior Lab/ Field Helper post at Punjab Agricultural University is 13th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the office by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Middle with Punjabi as their educational qualification to be eligible for the Junior Lab/ Field Helper position at PAU.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Lab/ Field Helper position?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants is between 18 to 63 years. Specific age relaxations are available for PWD and Ex-Servicemen categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How much is the application fee for the PAU Junior Lab/ Field Helper recruitment?
faq.answer: An application fee of Rs. 50/- is required for all categories of candidates applying for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Lab/ Field Helper post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a fixed monthly salary of Rs. 10,737/- on a contractual basis for the Junior Lab/ Field Helper role.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Lab/ Field Helper post at Punjab Agricultural University will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any experience required for the Junior Lab/ Field Helper post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates should have experience in working with rice, including sowing, harvesting, crossing, and germplasm maintenance. Preference will be given to those with prior field experiment or lab sample handling experience.

faq.question: Q8. How can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Punjab Agricultural University, www.pau.edu. Make sure to download the correct form from the website.

faq.question: Q9. Where should I send the application form?
faq.answer: The completed application form, along with attested copies of required documents and the bank draft, should be sent to the office of Punjab Agricultural University as mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the walk-in date for the interview?
faq.answer: The interview for the Junior Lab/ Field Helper position will be conducted on 20th August 2026. Candidates are advised to be present on time with all necessary documents.
